articles.title_en: Averaging impulse responses using prediction pools
articles.title_cn: 使用预测池对脉冲响应进行平均
articles.abstract_en: Macroeconomists construct impulse responses using many competing time series models and different statistical paradigms (Bayesian or frequentist). We adapt optimal linear prediction pools to efficiently combine impulse response estimators for the effects of the same economic shock from this vast class of possible models. We thus alleviate the need to choose one specific model, obtaining weights that are typically positive for more than one model. Our Monte Carlo simulations and empirical applications illustrate how the weights leverage the strengths of each model by (i) trading off properties of each model depending on variable, horizon, and application and (ii) accounting for the full predictive distribution rather than being restricted to specific moments.11MATLAB replication code is available on Matthes’ GitHub repository.
articles.abstract_cn: 宏观经济学家使用许多竞争性时间序列模型和不同的统计范式（贝叶斯或频率学派）构建脉冲响应。我们将最优线性预测池应用于有效组合来自这一广泛可能模型类别中同一经济冲击效应的脉冲响应估计量。因此，我们减轻了选择特定模型的需要，获得的权重通常对多个模型为正。我们的蒙特卡洛模拟和实证应用说明了权重如何通过（i）根据变量、视界和应用权衡每个模型的属性，以及（ii）考虑完整预测分布而非局限于特定矩，来利用每个模型的优势。11MATLAB复制代码可在Matthes的GitHub仓库中获取。

articles.title_en: (Trade) War and peace: How to impose international trade sanctions
articles.title_cn: (贸易)战争与和平：如何实施国际贸易制裁
articles.abstract_en: What is the most cost-efficient way to impose trade sanctions against Russia? We build a quantitative model of international trade with input–output connections. Sanctioning countries choose import tariffs to simultaneously maximize their income and minimize Russia’s income, with different weights placed on these objectives. We find, first, that for countries with low willingness to pay for sanctions against Russia, the most cost-efficient sanction is an approximately 20% tariff on all Russian products. Second, if countries are willing to pay at least US$0.70 for each US$1 drop in Russian welfare, an embargo on Russia’s mining and energy products is the most cost-efficient policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 对俄罗斯实施贸易制裁的最具成本效益的方式是什么？我们构建了一个具有投入产出联系的国际贸易定量模型。制裁国选择进口关税，以同时最大化其收入并最小化俄罗斯的收入，对这些目标赋予不同的权重。我们发现，首先，对于对制裁俄罗斯支付意愿较低的国家，最具成本效益的制裁是对所有俄罗斯产品征收约20%的关税。其次，如果各国愿意为俄罗斯福利每下降1美元支付至少0.70美元，那么对俄罗斯的采矿和能源产品实施禁运是最具成本效益的政策。

articles.title_en: The Fed takes on corporate credit risk: An analysis of the efficacy of the SMCCF
articles.title_cn: 美联储承担企业信用风险：SMCCF有效性分析
articles.abstract_en: This paper evaluates the efficacy of the Secondary Market Corporate Credit Facility, a program designed to stabilize the U.S. corporate bond market during the COVID-19 pandemic. The program announcements on March 23 and April 9, 2020, significantly reduced investment-grade credit spreads across the maturity spectrum – irrespective of the program’s maturity-eligibility criterion – and ultimately restored the normal upward-sloping term structure of credit spreads. The Federal Reserve’s actual purchases reduced credit spreads of eligible bonds 3 basis points more than those of ineligible bonds, a sizable effect given the modest volume of purchases. A calibrated variant of the preferred habit model shows that a “dash for cash” – a selloff of shorter-term lowest-risk investment-grade bonds – combined with a spike in the arbitrageurs’ risk aversion, can account for the inversion of the investment-grade credit curve during the height of turmoil in the market. Consistent with the empirical findings, the Fed’s announcements, by reducing risk aversion and alleviating market segmentation, helped restore the upward-sloping credit curve in the investment-grade segment of the market.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了二级市场企业信贷便利（SMCCF）的有效性，该计划旨在COVID-19大流行期间稳定美国公司债券市场。2020年三月23日和四月9日的计划公告显著降低了整个期限范围内的投资级信用利差——无论该计划的期限资格标准如何——并最终恢复了正常的向上倾斜的信用利差期限结构。美联储的实际购买使合格债券的信用利差比不合格债券低3个基点，考虑到购买量不大，这是一个相当大的效应。校准的偏好习惯模型变体表明，“现金争夺”——即短期最低风险投资级债券的抛售——加上套利者风险厌恶情绪的飙升，可以解释市场动荡最严重时期投资级信用曲线的倒挂。与实证结果一致，美联储的公告通过降低风险厌恶和缓解市场分割，帮助恢复了投资级市场板块向上倾斜的信用曲线。

articles.title_en: Adverse selection and search congestion in over-the-counter markets
articles.title_cn: 场外市场中的逆向选择与搜寻拥堵
articles.abstract_en: Asymmetric information about both private valuations of assets and their quality gives rise to uncertainty over sellers’ motives of trade, allowing high-valuation holders of low-quality assets to engage in speculative trades that involve no allocative gains. When sellers compete to find buyers, such speculative behaviour not only dilutes the average quality of assets but also creates a welfare-detrimental congestion externality that lengthens the time on market for each individual seller. A market designer can mitigate the inefficiencies by imposing a transaction tax and, in the case of severe adverse selection, limiting market participation.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于资产私人估值及其质量的信息不对称引发了对卖方交易动机的不确定性，使得持有低质量资产的高估值者能够从事不涉及配置收益的投机性交易。当卖方竞争寻找买方时，这种投机行为不仅稀释了资产的平均质量，还产生了损害福利的拥堵外部性，延长了每个个体卖方在市场上的时间。市场设计者可以通过征收交易税来缓解低效率，并且在严重逆向选择的情况下，限制市场参与。

articles.abstract_en: The proposed blended approach combines identification via heteroskedasticity with sign/narrative restrictions, and instrumental variables. Since heteroskedasticity can point identify shocks, its use results in a sharp reduction of the potentially large identified sets stemming from other approaches. Conversely, sign/narrative restrictions or instrumental variables offer natural solutions to the labeling problem and can help when conditions for point identification through heteroskedasticity are not met. Blending these methods together resolves their respective key issues and leverages their advantages. We illustrate the benefits of the approach in Monte Carlo experiments, and apply it to several examples taken from the literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 所提出的混合方法将异方差性识别与符号/叙事限制及工具变量相结合。由于异方差性可以点识别冲击，其使用导致其他方法产生的潜在较大识别集大幅缩减。相反，符号/叙事限制或工具变量为标签问题提供了自然解决方案，并在通过异方差性进行点识别的条件不满足时有所帮助。将这些方法混合在一起解决了它们各自的关键问题，并利用了它们的优势。我们在蒙特卡洛实验中展示了该方法的好处，并将其应用于文献中的几个例子。

articles.title_en: Cross-border regulatory spillovers and macroprudential policy coordination
articles.title_cn: 跨境监管溢出与宏观审慎政策协调
articles.abstract_en: We develop a core–periphery model with financial frictions and cross-border banking to assess the magnitude of regulatory spillovers and the gains from macroprudential policy coordination. A core global bank lends to its affiliates in the periphery and banks in both regions are subject to risk-sensitive capital regulation. Following an expansionary monetary policy in the core, a countercyclical response in capital requirements in that region induces the global bank to increase cross-border lending. We calculate welfare gains associated with countercyclical capital buffers under a range of policy regimes, including independent policymaking, full coordination, and reciprocity—a regime in which capital ratios set in the core are imposed on the global bank’s affiliates abroad. One of our key results is that, even when regulatory spillovers are strong, reciprocity can make all parties better off if regulators attach a sufficient weight to financial stability considerations. With a standard, utility-based welfare criterion, reciprocity may also perform better than independent policymaking when regulatory spillovers are weak.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个包含金融摩擦和跨境银行的核心-外围模型，以评估监管溢出的程度以及宏观审慎政策协调的收益。一个核心全球银行向其在外围地区的附属机构放贷，两个地区的银行都受到风险敏感资本监管的约束。在核心地区实施扩张性货币政策后，该地区资本要求的逆周期反应促使全球银行增加跨境贷款。我们计算了在多种政策制度下逆周期资本缓冲相关的福利收益，包括独立决策、全面协调以及互惠制度——在这种制度下，核心地区设定的资本比率适用于全球银行在国外的附属机构。我们的一个关键结果是，即使监管溢出很强，如果监管机构对金融稳定考虑给予足够权重，互惠可以使所有各方受益。使用标准的基于效用的福利标准，当监管溢出较弱时，互惠也可能优于独立决策。

articles.title_cn: 预期驱动的繁荣-萧条周期
articles.abstract_en: Using data from the Survey of Professional Forecasters, we observe that a large fraction of analysts’ expectations about future economic growth is not due to technology or other shocks to fundamentals measured by the business cycle literature. We find that these unexplained changes in forecast revisions predict significant boom-bust dynamics in the key macroeconomic aggregates. We offer a novel theory where boom-bust dynamics stem from expectation shocks orthogonal to fundamentals.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用专业预测者调查的数据，我们观察到，分析师对未来经济增长预期的很大一部分并非源于技术或商业周期文献所衡量的基本面冲击。我们发现，这些预测修正中无法解释的变化预示着关键宏观经济总量中显著的繁荣-萧条动态。我们提出了一种新颖的理论，其中繁荣-萧条动态源于与基本面正交的预期冲击。

articles.title_en: The consumption expenditure response to unemployment: Evidence from Norwegian households
articles.title_cn: 失业的消费支出反应：来自挪威 households 的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines heterogeneity in household income and consumption responses to unemployment, using granular administrative tax data from Norway. On average, unemployment results in a significant, lasting income reduction, accompanied by a decrease in consumption expenditures of between one-third to one-half of the income loss. We find that households with greater liquid assets at the outset experience less of a decline in consumption, whereas those with higher levels of debt encounter a more substantial decrease. Notably, also the interaction of liquid assets and debt holdings matters for the consumption response. While households with larger initial liquid asset holdings on average respond less, the analyses show that this is not the case among households that simultaneously hold substantial amounts of debt, thus adding to a more nuanced view of the importance of household heterogeneity for economic outcomes. Furthermore, our investigation into heterogeneity across family composition and child age uncovers distinct patterns in consumption responses, highlighting the varied impacts of unemployment. Lastly, we find that spending patterns, as indicated by the marginal propensity to consume (MPC), become more pronounced during recessions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用挪威的精细行政税收数据，考察了家庭收入和消费对失业反应的异质性。平均而言，失业导致收入显著且持久地减少，同时消费支出下降幅度为收入损失的三分之一至二分之一。我们发现，初始流动资产较多的家庭消费下降较少，而债务水平较高的家庭消费下降幅度更大。值得注意的是，流动资产与债务持有的交互作用对消费反应也很重要。虽然初始流动资产持有较多的家庭平均反应较小，但分析表明，在同时持有大量债务的家庭中并非如此，从而为家庭异质性对经济结果的重要性提供了更为细致的视角。此外，我们对家庭构成和子女年龄异质性的考察揭示了消费反应的不同模式，凸显了失业影响的多样性。最后，我们发现，以边际消费倾向（MPC）衡量的支出模式在经济衰退期间变得更加明显。
